Corollary
[irreducible symmetric spaces are Einstein]

Source: petersen:page-0399 ↗ thm:pet-ch10-parallel-tensor-eigenvalue 1. ch10:10.3.3A simply connected irreducible symmetric space is an Einstein manifold; in particular its curvature operator is nonnegative or nonpositive according to the sign of the Einstein constant.
